previous_statement: The preceding deduction is conditional on Co_{P_n,Q_n}=iota_n(Co_{P,Q}). Node 1.4 says precisely that this antecedent is unavailable from the allowed definitions: it would require amplification naturality of theta, which is not supplied. Accordingly no unconditional compressed-space equality is inferred here; node 1.5 has been amended to record only the valid conditional implication and the resulting failure to prove the root contract.
new_statement: Correction of the stale limitation in node 1.4: let Phi_n=iota_n:B(A)->B(M_n tensor A) be entrywise amplification. It is a bounded unital algebra homomorphism for operator composition. The registered definitions fix theta(U)=(I+sgn(U))/2 and sgn(U)=U(U^2)^{-1/2}, with the inverse square root given by one scalar norm-convergent power series. Hence, whenever the registered construction is defined at U and Phi_n(U), boundedness and multiplicativity of Phi_n permit passage through every partial sum and its norm limit, proving theta(Phi_n(U))=Phi_n(theta(U)). Applying this to U=B_{P,Q}, node 1.2 and def-compressed-corner give Co_{P_n,Q_n}=Phi_n(Co_{P,Q}); node 1.5.2 then gives S_{P_n,Q_n}=M_n tensor S_{P,Q}. Thus the earlier assertion that amplification naturality is unavailable is withdrawn and node 1.4 is superseded.
